skill_name: Explain how to write a good thesis statement.
workflow: A thesis statement is the central argument in a paper and is typically the last sentence in an introduction. It provides direction for a paper, pinpointing the main argument and expressing an opinion about that argument. To write a good thesis statement, define the purpose of your paper and make sure your argument is clear and direct.
